pages.text: Gear that sits on the desk beside a radio and works through it.$(li)$(item)Desk microphone$(): beside a radio. Hold right click on it to talk; sneak and right click to lock talking on. Speak close: it gets quieter as you step away, and lets go after 30 seconds.$(li)$(item)Hand mic$(): sneak and right click a radio with an empty hand to take its mic on a cord. Hold right click to talk; right click the radio to hang it up.$(li)$(item)Simplex repeat controller$(): echoes back what the radio hears after a delay, for testing your own signal.

pages.title: Digital and weather
pages.text: $(li)$(l:radiocraft:digital/aprs)Radio Interface$(/l): touches a VHF radio and turns it into a packet station: call sign and TX switch.$(li)$(l:radiocraft:digital/aprs)H19 terminal$(/l): touches the interface; beacons, the station list, messages and maps.$(li)$(l:radiocraft:digital/teletype)Teletype Machine$(/l): RTTY on paper through an HF radio, and the solar report.$(li)$(l:radiocraft:sky/wefax)WEFAX Receiver$(/l): weather charts from HF.
